limitations.quote: End the match pulse and retain the final 0
limitations.note: The patch correctly holds `s3_d011` across invalid cycles, but it also changes two exits from `s4_d0110` to retain an overlapping prefix where the original and reference both return to `idle`.

The test exhaustively checked short streams against a rolling valid-bit history that assumed overlapping matches, so it accepted the extra matches instead of catching the change to the original post-match behavior.
